notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (p5); Taxes split by the fund schedules (pp14, 16) and tied to the Statement of Activities general revenues (p2); Intergovernmental split by the fund schedules' rows (pp14, 16); Other split into NPPD lease and Franchise fees (p2) and the remaining fund 'Other' lines. Insurance proceeds 45,962 printed under other financing sources -> other_financing. Transfers: Total column prints none; fund columns General (506,431) out, CCC Inn 470,431 + Other governmental 36,000 in (p5). Governmental roll-forward on fund balance: 4,392,636 + 1,352,666 - 1,686,441 + 506,431 - 506,431 + 45,962 = 4,104,823. Cash fields: governmental funds cash and cash equivalents + cash at county treasurer (2021 comparative column for beginning); CDs, investments and restricted CDs in the investment fields. Business-type from the modified cash proprietary statements (pp9-10): 1,280,401 + 785,745 - 726,230 = 1,339,916; Miscellaneous operating revenue is in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities, so charges for services. proprietary from the modified cash Statement of Cash Flows (pp11-12); investing activities blank. Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position (p1), used because the governmental funds statement excludes capital assets. Grant lines with no grantor printed ('Grants', 'Donations and other grants') are category other, detail Grants. Detail: General Fund by department (pp14-15), Special Revenue combining (pp16-17, all 8 funds), utility funds from the supplementary accrual-basis proprietary statement (pp20-21, as FY2023/FY2024). Not recorded to avoid double counting: all-funds budget schedule (p13, combined), nonmajor combining (pp18-19, duplicates Recycling, Fire, Community Development, ARPA, TIF, Ambulance; Hoferer Trust has no activity), accrual cash flows (pp22-23).
